response:
Here is the corrected version of your text for Typora, with improvements for clarity and formatting:

Showing in \ref{fig:LCS}, the dataset is generated through the following steps:
\begin{enumerate}
    \item Split the document into sentences.
    \item Enumerate all unused sentence pairs within the document and generate their normalized copies.
    \item Calculate the Longest Common Subsequence (LCS) from the normalized copies using SuffixAutomaton \url{https://github.com/laohur/SuffixAutomaton}. A pair with a long enough LCS is considered a similar pair.
    \item Sample the similar pairs into the dataset.
    \item Sentences that exceed the maximum length will be randomly cropped \cite{izacard2022unsupervised} in the dataloader.
\end{enumerate}

This version uses an enumerated list for better readability and slightly rephrases some sentences for clarity.
